Welcome to Naked Wardrobe. I’m here to help you find the perfect fit or answer any questions.
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
If your item arrived damaged, the policy says to initiate an EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL and select the appropriate return reason.
You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the damage
- an image of the item
- an image of the care tag located on the inside of the garment
Their team will review the request, and IF IT’S APPROVED, YOU’LL RECEIVE AN EMAIL WITH A PREPAID LABEL.
I also found that ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and they can ONLY EXCHANGE THE SAME STYLE.
If you need help with your specific order, please log in so I can guide you further.
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Yes. If approved, the team will email you a prepaid label; a regular return just follows the standard portal flow and standard return policy.
Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Yes — for a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, you need to provide A PHOTO OF THE ITEM and A PHOTO OF THE CARE TAG INSIDE THE GARMENT, plus a brief description. You don’t email them separately; submit everything through the return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center.
